messages:
maya: Kicking off cohort-based blue->green shift for router v2.0. Plan: 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 10m step windows, change window 2025-09-15 02:00 UTC. Will pin long-lived sessions for 30m and enable circuit-breaker. Starting step 1 now if no objections.

maya: routing payload I'll use: 
```json
{
  "route": "api.*",
  "from": "blue-v1",
  "to": "green-v2",
  "steps_minutes": 10,
  "steps": [30,60,100]
}
```

axel: ack. watching p95 & 5xx. Add short-circuit at error_rate > 0.5% over 2m. Also ensure KV cache warmup for green.

sam: quick Q: websocket + long-poll sessions — cookie affinity might keep them on blue even after shift. What's our plan for sticky sessions?

nora: agree with sam. We should set LB cookie affinity (rw-session) with Max-Age=1800 for this window; also set header fallback `X-Session-Version` for newly created sessions.

axel: suggest incremental ramp timing: wait 12m after step to validate traces, and pre-approve auto-rollback thresholds: p95 +50ms or 5xx > 0.8% triggers immediate rollback.

maya: noted. I'll update the rollout config to include: `auto_rollback: {p95_delta_ms:50, error_rate_percent:0.8, eval_window:180}`. Pls ack so I can hit the deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: initiating traffic shift -> green at 30% (step 1/3). healthchecks: 18 checks running, 0 failing. canary_id=5312345678. watchers: perf,error-trace,uptime. auto-rollback thresholds set.

maya: holding at 30% now. Observations after 6m: p95 +12ms, 5xx stable at 0.12%. No immediate regressions in traces. Proceed to 60% in ~6m unless flagged.

axel: I'm on watch. I've wired `alerts/traffic_shift` to notify on p95 > baseline+50ms OR error_rate > 0.5% for 2m. Also created a temporary dashboard slice: /dash/shift-5312345678

sam: note on DBs: green should be read-only for any pending migration. Do we have schema compatibility confirmed? If not, rollback could surface errors. @maya confirm.

maya: confirmed — migrations applied to replicas prior to shift; green uses compatible read path. release notes updated: "Router v2.0: kernel path improvements, keepalive fixes, sticky-cookie v2 required."

nora: I added a small preflight probe to the release: `./scripts/probe.sh --route api --cluster green` and pushed a blurb to GH release notes and the change window doc. Tagging canary cluster `green-cohort-2025-09-15`.

deploy-bot: status update: step 1 complete (30% stable). Next step (60%) scheduled in 9m. No auto-rollback triggered. logs: https://logs.example.com/5312345678

maya: Good. Quick rollback playbook if we need it: graceful drain back to blue over 3m, evict green KV caches, and pin sessions to blue for 30m. Playbook ref: /playbooks/rollback-router.md. If immediate emergency, we can force 100% pin to blue (instant-fallback) — but prefer graceful.

axel: +1 to graceful. If rollback occurs, follow 'instant-fallback' pattern in the playbook: set `route.pin=blue-100`, disable warmup on green, and run `scripts/evict-kv --cluster green`.

sam: LGTM. I'll keep an eye on websocket metrics.

nora: :thumbsup: will update the post-deploy checklist once we hit 100%.

maya: Thanks team — I'll post final status after 60% step.
